subaward_description:
PURPOSE
THE SUBCONTRACTOR SHALL PROVIDE CYBERSECURITY SUBJECT MATTER EXPERTISE AND DOCUMENTATION SUPPORT NECESSARY TO SATISFY THE CYBERSECURITY REQUIREMENTS APPLICABLE TO FACILITY-RELATED CONTROL SYSTEMS (FRCS) UNDER:
• UFC 4-010-06, CYBERSECURITY OF FACILITY-RELATED CONTROL SYSTEMS
• UFGS 25-05-11, CYBERSECURITY FOR FACILITY-RELATED CONTROL SYSTEMS
THIS EFFORT SUPPORTS THE PNEUMATIC TUBE SYSTEM (PTS) ONLY UNDER TASK ORDER W912DY-25-F-A228 AT WALTER REED NATIONAL MILITARY MEDICAL CENTER.
2. SCOPE LIMITATIONS
THIS SUBCONTRACT INCLUDES CYBERSECURITY DOCUMENTATION AND ADVISORY SUPPORT ONLY.
THIS SUBCONTRACT EXPLICITLY EXCLUDES:
• AUTHORIZATION TO OPERATE (ATO)
• RISK MANAGEMENT FRAMEWORK (RMF) PACKAGE DEVELOPMENT
• SYSTEM OWNER (SO) OR AUTHORIZING OFFICIAL (AO) DETERMINATIONS
• CONTINUOUS MONITORING
• ENTERPRISE IT ACCREDITATION
• PENETRATION TESTING
• STIG IMPLEMENTATION BEYOND DOCUMENTATION AND REPORTING
• NETWORK HARDWARE PROCUREMENT
• SYSTEM INTEGRATION BEYOND DOCUMENTATION SUPPORT
SUBCONTRACTOR SHALL NOT REPRESENT TO THE GOVERNMENT THAT ATO OR RMF SERVICES ARE INCLUDED.
3. DESIGN PHASE SUPPORT (UFC 4-010-06)
SUBCONTRACTOR SHALL PROVIDE CYBERSECURITY DOCUMENTATION AND ADVISORY SUPPORT DURING:
• 65% DESIGN
• 100% DESIGN
• CORRECTED FINAL REVIEW (CFR)
DELIVERABLES SHALL INCLUDE:
1.	CYBERSECURITY NARRATIVE FOR THE PNEUMATIC TUBE SYSTEM
2.	TAILORED CONTROL CORRELATION IDENTIFIER (CCI) LIST
3.	TAILORED UFGS 25-05-11 SPECIFICATION SECTION
4.	IDENTIFICATION OF DESIGNER-RESPONSIBLE CCIS
5.	REVIEW COMMENTS ON CONTROL SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE
6.	COORDINATION INPUT ON NETWORK/DATA FLOW DIAGRAMS
ALL DELIVERABLES SHALL BE PROVIDED IN EDITABLE FORMAT COMPATIBLE WITH PRIME SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS.
4. BUILD PHASE SUPPORT (UFGS 25-05-11)
SUBCONTRACTOR SHALL PREPARE THE FOLLOWING DOCUMENTATION FOR THE PNEUMATIC TUBE SYSTEM:
1.	STIG/SRG APPLICABILITY REPORT
2.	CYBERSECURITY INTERCONNECTION SCHEDULE
3.	NETWORK COMMUNICATION REPORT
4.	CONTROL SYSTEM INVENTORY REPORT
5.	CYBERSECURITY RISER DIAGRAM
6.	STIG/SRG/VENDOR COMPLIANCE RESULT REPORT
7.	CONTROL SYSTEM CYBERSECURITY DOCUMENTATION PACKAGE
8.	SOFTWARE RECOVERY AND RECONSTITUTION IMAGE SUPPORT DOCUMENTATION
SUBCONTRACTOR SHALL COORDINATE REQUIRED TECHNICAL DATA WITH THE PRIME AND SYSTEM VENDORS.
SUBCONTRACTOR IS RESPONSIBLE FOR DOCUMENTATION ACCURACY BUT IS NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR VENDOR IMPLEMENTATION OF FIRMWARE OR CONFIGURATION CHANGES.
5. COORDINATION REQUIREMENTS
SUBCONTRACTOR SHALL:
• ATTEND CYBERSECURITY COORDINATION MEETINGS AS REQUESTED
• SUPPORT PRIME DURING GOVERNMENT DESIGN REVIEWS
• PROVIDE RESPONSES TO GOVERNMENT CYBERSECURITY COMMENTS WITHIN FIVE (5) BUSINESS DAYS
• REVISE DOCUMENTATION TO ADDRESS GOVERNMENT COMMENTS WITHIN FIVE (5) BUSINESS DAYS
SUBCONTRACTOR SHALL NOT COMMUNICATE DIRECTLY WITH THE GOVERNMENT REGARDING SCOPE, COST, OR CONTRACTUAL MATTERS WITHOUT WRITTEN AUTHORIZATION FROM THE PRIME.
ALL GOVERNMENT-FACING COMMUNICATION SHALL BE COORDINATED THROUGH THE PRIME CONTRACTOR.
6. SCHEDULE ALIGNMENT
SUBCONTRACTOR DELIVERABLES SHALL ALIGN WITH THE PRIME’S APPROVED PROJECT SCHEDULE.
SUBCONTRACTOR SHALL NOT DELAY:
• 65% SUBMISSION
• 100% SUBMISSION
• CFR SUBMISSION
• PRE-FINAL INSPECTION
• SUBSTANTIAL COMPLETION
FAILURE TO DELIVER CYBERSECURITY DOCUMENTATION IN ACCORDANCE WITH SCHEDULE THAT RESULTS IN GOVERNMENT REJECTION OR DELAY SHALL BE CONSIDERED SUBCONTRACTOR-CAUSED DELAY.
7. LIABILITY AND FLOW-DOWN
SUBCONTRACTOR SHALL:
• COMPLY WITH ALL APPLICABLE FEDERAL CYBERSECURITY REGULATIONS INCORPORATED INTO THE PRIME CONTRACT
• FLOW DOWN APPLICABLE CLAUSES FROM W912DY-25-F-A228
• MAINTAIN PROFESSIONAL LIABILITY INSURANCE
LIMITATION OF LIABILITY SHALL NOT RELIEVE SUBCONTRACTOR OF RESPONSIBILITY FOR DELAYS OR REWORK CAUSED BY DEFICIENT DOCUMENTATION.
8. DELIVERABLE ACCEPTANCE
DELIVERABLES SHALL BE CONSIDERED COMPLETE ONLY WHEN:
• ACCEPTED BY THE PRIME CONTRACTOR
• SUBMITTED TO THE GOVERNMENT
• NOT REJECTED FOR NON-COMPLIANCE
SUBCONTRACTOR SHALL CORRECT REJECTED DELIVERABLES AT NO ADDITION
